## Checklist

- [ ] `npm test` passes, and `npm run check:sources` passes for a new or changed plugin
- [ ] `.claude-plugin/marketplace.json` is regenerated with `npm run sync`
- [ ] A line is added under "Unreleased" in `CHANGELOG.md`, or the change needs the label "no changelog"
- [ ] The README's plugin table is updated if a plugin was added, renamed or removed
